expectations.text: Advises against the reflexive smart/dumb/styles 3-way split
expectations.evidence: "don't do the classic three-way split"; "Skip the container/presentational split."

expectations.text: Recommends extracting a hook (abstraction) instead of splitting container/view files
expectations.evidence: Provides useSavedCards() hook code and states "extract an abstraction, not files"; "Abstraction before file structure."

expectations.text: Notes ~180 lines is acceptable as one file (raised size threshold)
expectations.evidence: "180 lines of one coherent concern is not too big"; ceiling "a few hundred lines" / "~300 lines".

expectations.text: Grounds advice in AI agents' reluctance to read adjacent files / cross-file context cost
expectations.evidence: "AI agents... remarkably reluctant to open adjacent files"; "doubled the cross-file lookups the agent is least likely to perform."
